info.name: Morphinia — Genius API
info.description: Discovery calls against the Genius API for L'Morphine's catalog. Auth is Bearer via the {{genius_token}} collection variable — paste your Client Access Token there, never into a request body or URL.

request.description: Look through response.hits for the entry whose primary_artist is really him, then copy primary_artist.id into the artist_id variable. If nothing looks right, edit the q value and resend (try just "Morphine", or the exact spelling from his genius.com profile URL).
Sanity check that artist_id is correct — confirms name, image, genius url.
One page of the artist's songs. Check response.next_page — if it's not null, bump the page query param and resend to get the rest. Grab any one song's id for request 4.
Richest metadata for one song (album, writers, release date, etc). Does NOT include lyrics text — that only lives on the genius.com page at response.song.url.
